name: top30-private
description: Nothing leaves the machine without a yes. The egress gate hook asks before a command, skill or connector sends data out, and before anything carries personal data or secrets. claude-mem-private installs Claude-Mem with telemetry off, no cloud sync, no cmem.ai sign-in and a local Ollama observer; ecc-private installs ECC with ask-first rules for codex, astra-review and Ito. Both audit what they set.
